EventItemActionText: The Board of Architectural Review met for a work session Tuesday August 17, 2021 at 7:30 pm in the Vienna Town Hall at 127 Center St S. Present in town hall were Chairman Roy Baldwin, Vice-Chair Michael Cheselka, Patty Hanley, Paul Layer.  Linda van Doorn was present via Zoom.  Town Attorney Steve Briglia, Planning and Zoning Director Cindy Petkac, Planner Andrea West, and Board Clerk Sharmaine Abaied were present in Town Hall.

Resolution for Continuity of Government

Roll Call: Ms. van Doorn, Mr. Layer, Mr. Baldwin, Mr. Cheselka, and Ms. Hanley were present.
EventItemTitle: Board of Architectural Review - Continuity of Government

EventItemActionText:
Mr. Chris Bell of Hekemian and Co and Mr. Kamran Charmsaz of KTGY Group were present to discuss the exterior modifications to 444 Maple Ave W.  

The applicant and the board reviewed the plans in detail moving through all the design changes and then proceeded to review the materials one section at a time moving around each elevation
 
The board felt there was insufficient time to complete the review so they summarized the items they would like to see updated and noted items in need of review for their next work session. 
 
The board would like to see a rendering that more truly represents the colors and updates the configurations to include the recommended changes.  Specifically, the balconies with extended roof on the upper floor along Maple Avenue, replacing the proposed dormer, increasing the articulation of the cornice and parapet along the Nutley St. elevation, revert back to the drawings with the arches at the rear garage by using an engaged arch and infill underneath the arch with complimentary brick pattern.  In addition, the board still needs to review the retail plan, the landscape plan, the lighting plan and the interior ceiling design for the arcade areas.

Materials/ items for the applicant to provide
     Updated renderings
     6 & #8 Hardiboard samples
     #3 Brick alternative with a redder quality, not the blonde (to review)
     Storefront colors
     Fabric Awnings
     Awning specifications 
     Picture and detail of standing seam roofs
     Mortar selections  
     Plaza materials
All plans and materials should be clearly labeled and referenced on the plan.
The meeting was adjourned at 9:58 pm

Respectfully Submitted, 
Sharmaine Abaied
Board Clerk
EventItemTitle: 444 Maple Ave W - Exterior Modifications - Mixed-Use
